exposure: Maternal comorbidities (gestational hypertension, gestational diabetes, prior cesarean scar)
cohort: The study included 185 pregnancies at a Romanian tertiary center from 2021-2024, with high-risk HPV DNA testing <=24 weeks and thyroid profiling.
finding: High-risk HPV combined with maternal comorbidity was associated with increased cesarean and preterm-birth risk, with a significant interaction for HPV x prior cesarean scar on preterm birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean odds were higher for HPV-negative with any comorbidity (aOR 2.9) and highest for HPV-positive with comorbidity (aOR 4.3) compared to HPV-negative without comorbidity.
